generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work to understand the very nature of work, methodology, technicalities, work preparedness etc., before submission of their ten

Modification to the release of APS conditions of contract: If the percentage quoted by the contractor for the work is below 90% of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender of the Department, then the contractor shall furnish an additional performance security in the form of Bank Guarantee for an amount equivalent to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and 90% of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender. In case of contractor quoted rates above 125% of the estimated rates, then the amount over and above 125% will be held during the progress of work. The additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of the entire cost of the work as per the agreement

The necessary certificates/documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to their e-tender documents. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced on or before stipulated date and time for verification
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day is valid
Further information can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, No.1, T.R Division, Munirabad during office hours email id trdmrb at gmail.com

Conditional tenders will be rejected and E.M.D. will be forfeited. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
Corrigendum will be published in the web site for all modifications/corrections if any

The intending bidders should note that, if any of lands either in part/parts or whole required for the work is not acquired by the Nigam/Department it shall be the responsibility of the bidder to take possession of such land and start the work by consent of the land owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigam/Department and no claim whatsoever relating to non availability of land is acceptable
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address and e-mail address in the declaration form
All materials like sand, Jelly, Stones, Wood / Rubble steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only
The contractor/firm shall send the authorization letter of their representatives duly attested by their signature
The Tender processing charges paid by the bidders are non-refundable, even if their tenders are cancelled
Incomplete tender documents will be summarily rejected
As per the Karnataka building and other construction Workers Welfare Cess Act 1996 , 1% of the bill amount will be deducted from each bill
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their authorized agents
The contractor / Firm / Company should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by them under any circumstances, without linking to the pending bill payment of the work
Typo-graphical errors (if any) will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
Maintenance period or the defect liability period for this works is 12 months from the date of completion of work
EMD of the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the Competent Authority
